class LawoAmicDevice(LawoHomeNativeDevice):

    def __init__(self, nats_servers: list[str], nats_port: int = 4222):
        super().__init__(nats_servers, nats_port=nats_port)
        self.spec = HomeNativeDeviceSpec(
            type_number="985/01",
            model="A__mic8",
            terminals={
                'inputs': {
                    'Mic/Line': 8,
                },
                'outputs': {

                }
            },
